description: This file provides a weather service API for a React application, including functions to fetch current weather data from OpenWeatherMap and to get the user's geolocation with a timeout.

methods.name: fetchCurrentWeather({ city, lat, lon, units = "metric" } = {})
methods.description: Fetches current weather data from OpenWeatherMap using city name or geographic coordinates, with optional units parameter. Handles API response and errors, returning a simplified weather object.

methods.name: getBrowserLocation(timeoutMs = 5000)
methods.description: Gets the user's current geographic location with a specified timeout, returning latitude and longitude.
